raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.zone = 'JFK Airport' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN T2.zone = 'LaGuardia Airport' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN T2.zone = 'Newark Airport' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips AS T1 INNER JOIN zones AS T2 ON T1.do_location_id = T2.location_id WHERE T1.trip_distance > 20
